title: Disable mouse acceleration with libinput
summary: Set the mouse pointer to move 1:1 with your hand by disabling acceleration. This is useful for gaming or precise work.

steps.explain: List input devices to find the ID of your mouse.
Set the acceleration profile to 'flat' (no acceleration) for the device. Replace <DEVICE_ID> with the number found in the previous step.
